Title: What's my clan? or, Clan Impersonation questions

Messages.Author: Art Martella
Messages.Body:
What happens if someone gets a clan-specific card played on them, and
then clan impersonates another clan? For example, what happens if Igo
the Hungry Impersonates a Gangrel, and is then voted Gangrel Justicar,
but then he burns Clan Impersonation as an action. He is now a Caitiff
Gangrel Justicar. Then Yong-Sun, Harmonist, tells Igo "Hey kid, I'm
your sire", using Revelation of the Sire. He's now a
Nosferatu-ANTITRIBU. And the Gangrel Justicar. Then, for fun, he
decides he doesn't like the title of Justicar, so puts a bunch of master
discipline cards on himself (1 Protean, 1 Presence, 2 Chimerstries, 1
Thaumaturgy, 1 Serpentis, and 1 Obtenebration), and is voted Sabbat
Cardinal using Cardinal Benediction. Then he's declared a pretty boy
using Unacceptable Appearance, so he's a Pander now. He then finds a
writ of acceptance, is voted in as Prince of Geneva, and then Clan
Impersonates a Gangrel (AGAIN... No really, I'm a Gangrel. Really. I
mean it.), and then Mehemet blows up the Serpentis card.

Poor fool.

So, what is he, what's his blood capacity, and how soon will someone
Bums Rush him with Samantha and put him out of his misery?

Other questions:

1) When he burned Clan Impersonation and became a Caitiff, did he stay
Gangrel Justicar?

2) When he became a Nosferatu-ANTITRIBU, did he become Sabbat?

3) If Mehemet would have come out earlier, and blew up the Chimerstries,
Thaumaturgy, and Protean cards after he was voted Cardinal, would he
lose his Cardinality?

4) Why didn't anyone Golconda his sorry butt a long time ago?

By the way:

1) Is Caitiff a clan?

2) Is Pander a clan?

3) Are Caitiff considered Camarilla? (In the Sabbat rules sheet it says
the Camarilla is "the vampires of the seven accepted bloodlines")

4) THEREFORE, could Igo have skipped all the pain and misery he caused
and just become Prince of Geneva to start with?

That's enough for now.

I think.

Or not.

The Sabbat Rules Sheet is pretty explicit in defining the distinction,
and in classifying Pander as a clan. The WoD backstory is not
relevant, since the rules are so explicit.

> > >3) Are Caitiff considered Camarilla? (In the Sabbat rules sheet it says
> > >the Camarilla is "the vampires of the seven accepted bloodlines")
> > Yes.
>
> You're starting to sound like the "replying machines" sometimes
> we see answering our questions :)
> I know these are hard questions whose answer have no real
> explanation, but please try to keep some blood on your veins :)

These questions are actually easy, because they are so clear cut
as to not require any explanation. I don't understand the
problem with the answer.

> > >4) THEREFORE, could Igo have skipped all the pain and misery he caused
> > >and just become Prince of Geneva to start with?
> > Yes. (But, he wouldn't get the capacity boost, since he isn't a gangrel).
>
> Does that mean that he gets the capacity boost at the moment he
> calls the praxis, and it remains so wether he changes clans or not?

No. The title (Glasgow) increases his capacity when he is
Gangrel. If he ceases to be Gangrel, he ceases to receive the
increace to capacity. If he becomes Gangrel, he gains the increase.
